note: Product authority. Status labels are honest: Available means you can engage today. In development means real work is underway and documented. Future means direction, not a promise date.

products.name: PingFyd
products.tagline: AI front desk and business automation, set up for home service businesses
products.summary: Practical automation consulting for independent home service businesses. We study how your business actually works, then recommend and implement the automation that fits: reliable inquiry capture, fast consistent response, follow-up that actually happens, review systems, and less administrative drag. Consultative, not packaged. Measurable value or the engagement does not continue.
offers: Workflow discovery: we learn your business before recommending anything
Reliable capture: every inquiry, job detail, and follow-up lands somewhere it cannot disappear
Response systems: acknowledgment in minutes, not days
Follow-up sequences: estimates, check-ins, and review requests that run without relying on memory
Review and reputation systems: happy customers asked at the right moment, problems surfaced early
notOffers: Systems you cannot understand or maintain

products.name: PING
products.tagline: The system underneath: it remembers everything, shows its evidence, and works only within the limits it is given
products.summary: The system underneath everything: it keeps a continuous record of what happened, works only within the authority it is given, shows the evidence behind every answer, and can replay a decision to prove how it was reached. Real architecture, documented on this site as it is built. Not a product you can buy; the consultancy applies its principles to real businesses today.
documented: Continuity: events as source truth, knowledge that accumulates, evidence attached to claims
Agents: capability boundaries, stdin-based machine execution, reversible by default
Evidence: verification grades, contradiction preservation, typed failure semantics
Replay: deterministic ordering from the same causal history

products.name: Websites on TenantOS
products.tagline: Websites for many businesses on one shared platform, each with its own content and brand
products.summary: The platform direction this site proves: many businesses on one shared system, each defined by its own content, brand, and domain, never a separate copy of the code. This website is tenant one. Websites for other businesses on this model are future work, not an offering today.
products.proof: This site: its identity, brand, navigation, and search presence all come from one versioned tenant record. Restyling it is a settings change, not a code change.
